title: 第11章 以道为尺以义为衡第12章 正式任务和福利任务相差这么多
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
云想衣完全没在意下方因她一句话而掀起的惊涛骇浪，只是伸了个懒腰，随意指向那测灵石柱的最顶端——
“诸位可别看错了眼。”
“瞧瞧那顶上，可是有裂痕了呢。”
裂痕？
所有人都下意识地顺着云想衣手指的方向看向石柱顶端——
原本光滑无比的石柱最顶端，竟然真的蔓延开了几道细微得几乎无法察觉的细小裂痕。
温郗：……
苍天作证，她真的已经用最快的速度收回手了，没想到还是轻微毁坏了测灵石柱。
那什么，她可以进了学院后通过义务劳动来赔偿吗？
人群又开始骚乱起来，他们心中有个猜测却又不敢不愿相信。
难道……
测灵石柱承载不住温郗的天赋？
云想衣终于完全睁眼，落在温郗身上的目光带着一丝好奇和玩味。
她顿了顿，红唇勾起一抹弧度，一字一句，清晰无比：“她是——”
“神级，木灵根。”
这句话带来的震撼，远比刚刚看到的一切都更让人失语。
神级灵根——
只存在于典籍记载中从未出现过的至高天赋，竟然真的在他们眼前降临了？
云想衣突然笑了，对着几位峰主传音——
“冰块，苏老，你们两个记得重新打造一块测灵石柱，以温郗的标准来——既然破了记录，我们也要与时俱进修改啊。”

苏半夏抬手：“行。”
冷千双淡淡点头。
说完这句，云想衣又看向温郗。
“天道赐了你绝佳的天赋，小温郗，可别让祂失望哦~”
“看在神级木灵根的份上，我就不计较你打扰我睡觉咯。”
温郗一愣，左右观察了一下别人的神色，便明白这句话是云想衣对她的识海传音。
云想衣对着温郗眨了眨眼，潋滟的狐狸眼中尽是期待和调侃。
她仿佛只是随口说了一件微不足道的小事，打个哈欠后便像来的时候那样，又悄无声息地消失在空气中。
只留下石化般的众人。
他们再度将视线放在了温郗身上。
青云道院历代天才辈出，但这一届出了一位绝无仅有的天才。
——————
所有人测试完成后，时间也不早了。
鹿辞霜和凉望津在吵架，萧杙与向山在一旁拉架，温郗则是抬头看着天空。
嘶……她怎么总觉得这上面空间波动有点大啊。
content_en:
Yun Xiangyi didn't pay any attention to the turmoil caused by her words below. She just stretched her body and pointed at the top of the spirit-detecting stone pillar——
"Don't make the wrong mistake."
"Look at the top, there are cracks."
Crack?
Everyone subconsciously followed the direction of Yun Xiangyi's finger and looked towards the top of the stone pillar——
The top of the originally smooth stone pillar actually had a few tiny cracks that were almost imperceptible.
Wen Xi:......
Cangtian testified that she had really retracted her hand as quickly as possible, but unexpectedly, she still slightly damaged the spirit-detecting stone pillar.
So what, can she compensate through voluntary labor after entering the academy?
The crowd started to riot again. They had a guess in their minds but they didn't dare to believe it.
Could it be...
Can't the spiritual stone pillar bear Wen Xi's talent?
Yun Xiangyi finally opened her eyes completely, and her gaze on Wen Xi was filled with curiosity and amusement.
She paused, her red lips curved, and every word was very clear: "She is -"
"God level, wood spirit root."
The shock brought by this sentence is far more speechless than everything I just saw.
God-level spiritual root——
The supreme talent that only existed in ancient records and had never appeared before actually appeared before their eyes?
Yun Xiangyi suddenly smiled and sent a message to several peak masters——
"Ice cube, Mr. Su, you two remember to build a new spirit-measuring stone pillar according to Wen Xi's standards - since the record has been broken, we must keep pace with the times and revise it."
Su Banxia raised her hand: "Okay."
Leng Qianshuang nodded lightly.
After saying this, Yun Xiangyi looked at Wen Xi again.
"Heaven has given you an excellent talent, little Wen Xi, don't let Him down~"
"For the sake of my god-level wood spirit roots, I won't care if you disturb my sleep."
Wen Xi was stunned for a moment, and after observing the expressions of others, he understood that these words were Yun Xiangyi's voice transmitted to her from the sea of consciousness.
Yun Xiangyi blinked at Wen Xi, her foxy eyes full of expectation and ridicule.
She seemed to have just said a trivial matter casually, yawned and then disappeared into the air as quietly as she came.
Only the petrified people were left.
They once again set their sights on Wen Xi.
Qingyun Taoist Academy has produced many geniuses in the past generations, but this year there was a unique genius.
——————
After everyone's testing was completed, it was already getting late.
Lu Cishuang and Liang Wangjin were quarreling, Xiao Zhu and Xiang Shan were arguing at the side, and Wen Xi looked up at the sky.
Hiss...Why does she always feel that the space fluctuations up here are a bit big?
